pavattavacana: [ pavatta + vacana ] (na) CL=7 (1) The words (sound) that arise. (2) Saddā that arises or appears.
pavattavacanapaṭikkhepakaraṇa: [ pavattavacana + paṭikkhepakaraṇa ] (na) CL=7 Making the rejection of the statement that arises.

pavattavedha: [ pavatta + vedha ] (pu) CL=7 Which is piercing or penetrating.

pavattaviññāṇa: [ pavatta + viññāṇa ]  CL=9 The Paṭhamāruppa consciousness that arises.

pavattavohāravacana: [ pavatta + vohāravacana ] (na) CL=7 The words (sound) of verbal expression that happen.
pavattavācā: [ pavattā + vācā ] (thī) CL=7 Word (sound) that appears.

pavattavāda: [ pavatta + vāda ] (pu) CL=7 (1) The doctrine that believes. (Ti) (2) One who has a doctrine.

pavattaye: [ pa + vatu (vatta, vattu) + ṇaya + eyya ] (kā, kri) CL=7 (He) should be. See - Pavattayati.

pavattayi: [ pa + vatu (vatta, vattu) + ṇaya + ī ] (kā, kri) CL=7 (A) He caused to turn forward. (B) He made a devotional offering. See - Pavattayati.

pavattayituṃ: [ pa + vatu (vatta, vattu) + ṇaya + tuṃ ] (kā, kri, vi) CL=7 To cause.

pavattañāṇamukha: [ pavatta + ñāṇamukha ]  CL=9 with a face of wisdom that arises. (The one with the face of wisdom that turns.)
pavattañāṇasabhāva: [ pavatta + ñāṇasabhāva ] (ti) CL=7 The nature of insight that arises.

pavattaāvajjanā: [ pavattā + āvajjanā ] (thī) CL=7 Contemplates (on sense object) that arise.
pavattaīhitika: [ pavattaīhiti + ṇika ] (ti) CL=7 The manner (of mind) that arises.

pavattenti: [ pa + vatu (vatta, vattu) + ṇe + anti ] (kā, kri) CL=7 They cause to happen or exist. See - Pavattenti. (A) They cause to happen or exist, to turn forward and preach. [ pa + vatu (vatta, vattu) + ṇe + eyyaṃ ] (kā, kri) CL=7 I will cause to happen or exist. See - Pavatteti.
pavatteyyaṃ: [ pa + vatu (vatta, vattu) + ṇe + eyyaṃ ] (kā, kri) CL=7 I will cause to happen or exist. See - Pavatteti.
pavatti: [ pa + vatu (vatta, vattu) + ti. Vutta-nto tu pavatti. Dhāna. 113. Pavattante kā-riyā yassaṃ patattīti. Dhāna, ṭī. 113. Pavā-ho tu pavatti ca. Dhāna. 768. Vatu ā-vattane,ti, pavatti. Dhāna, ṭī. 768. ] (thī) CL=7 (1) (A) Being. (b) Nīvaraṇa is active. (B) The continuum of the doer happens the cause that will be the consequence. (D) Preaching (E) Turning forward. (2) A manner of a cause. The state of affairs. The information words (sound). The way of happening. The way things happen.  (3) The feeling or suffering that is five aggregate embodying that is the cyclic suffering - being continuously. (4) The stream of water. (5) The present life or the life that happens in a realm. (6) Causes to be. (7) The place where (one) is being or a place of being or happening. (8) The succession. In succession. (9) (A) A moment of existing or happening. (B) A period of being or happening (from a moment of thī of conception consciousness to bhaṅga of death consciousness). A period of pavatti. (10) Anulomapaṭiccasamuppāda. (11) Taṇhā. (12) Being in saṃsarā. (13) Truth of suffering.

pavattiajānana: [ pavatti + ajānana ] (na) CL=7 Not understanding the way things happen.
pavattiattha: [ pavatti + attha ] (pu) CL=7 (1) The meaning of happening or being. (2) The benefit or result of being or happening.
pavattibhedabhinna: [ pavattibheda + bhinna ] (ti) CL=7 Splits apart by the variety of happening or existing.
pavattibhedadassana: [ pavattibheda + dassana ] (na) CL=7 Seeing the variety of happening or existing.
pavattibhedana: [ pavatti + bhedana ] (na) CL=7 The variety of the way of happening or existing.
pavattibhāvanivāraṇa: [ pavattibhāva + nivāraṇa ] (na) CL=7 Prohibits or blocks a state of happening or being.
pavattibhāvappakāsana: [ pavattibhāva + pakāsana ] (na) CL=7 The verse that indicates the existence of the obvious of being.

pavattidhammamagga: [ pavattidhamma + magga ]  CL=9 A cause of vaṭṭa dhamma that happens continuously.

pavattidukkhapaṭipakkha: [ pavattidukkha + paṭipakkha ] (pu) CL=7 The opposite of cyclic suffering.
pavattidvāra: [ pavatti + dvāra ] (na) CL=7 (a) A cause of happening or being. (B) A cause of preaching the sermon.
pavattidvāralakkhaṇa: [ pavattidvāra + lakkhaṇa ] (na) CL=7 The sign of a cause of preaching or teaching.
pavattidvārapidhāna: [ pavattidvāra + pidhāna ] (na) CL=7 Prohibits or blocks a cause of happening.
pavattidīpana: [ pavatti + dīpana ] (thī, na) CL=7 The words (sound) that explain a state of happening.
pavattiekadesa: [ pavatti + ekadesa ] (pu) CL=7 Which is a part of pavatti. See - Pavattivipāka.
pavattiggahaṇa: [ pavatti + gahaṇa ] (na) CL=7 The words (sound) that explain taking the manner of happening.
pavattihetu: [ pavatti + hetu ] (pu) CL=7 (1) A cause of happening or existing. (2) A cause of the vaṭta dhamma. (3) A cause of existence or establishment.
pavattihetukarajakāya: [ pavattihetu + karajakāya ] (pu) CL=7 The physical body that is a cause of happening or existing.
pavattihita: [ pavatti + hita ] (ti) CL=7 Having prosperity in the present life.
pavattijotana: [ pavatti + jotana ] (ti) CL=7 Points out a state of happening.
pavattika: [ pavatti + ka ] (ti) CL=7 Happening or existing or being.
pavattikamma: [ pavattita + kamma ] (na) CL=7 An action that causes to happen.
pavattikathābhāva: [ pavattikathā + bhāva ] (pu) CL=7 As the words (sound) said the cyclic suffering dhamma that is happening continuously.
pavattikhandha: [ pavatti + khandha ] (pu) CL=7 The aggregate embodying that happens.
pavattikicca: [ pavatti + kicca ] (ti) CL=7 Having the function of being or happening.
pavattikkama: [ pavatti + kama ] (pu) CL=7 The sequence of happening. Process.
pavattikkamanidassana: [ pavattikkama + nidassana ] (na) CL=7 The word that explains the sequence of happening or process.
pavattikkhaṇa: [ pavatti + khaṇa ] (pu) CL=7 A period of being or happening. A moment of happening. A moment when (something) happens.
pavattikāla: [ pavatti + kāla ] (pu) CL=7 (1) A period of being or happening. (2) A period of pavatti.
pavattikāraṇa: [ pavatti + kāraṇa ] (na) CL=7 A cause of being or happening.
pavattikāraṇasammūḷha: [ pavattikāraṇa + sammūḷha ] (ti) CL=7 One who is very confused analyzing a cause of being or happening.
pavattikāraṇavibhāga: [ pavattikāraṇa + vibhāga ] (pu) CL=7 A superior state that analyzes what is and what is not the cause.
pavattikāraṇavibhāgasaṃmūḷha: [ pavattikāraṇavibhāga + saṃmūḷha ] (sammūḷha) (ti) CL=7 One who is very confused analyzing a cause of being or happening.
pavattilakkhaṇa: [ pavatti + lakkhaṇa ] (ti) CL=7 Having the characteristic of happening or existing in succession. Should be recognized the forms are happening continuously.
pavattimagga: [ pavatti + magga ] (pu) CL=7 A cause of happening or existing.
pavattimahāvāra: [ pavatti + mahāvāra ] (pu) CL=7 A great occasion that is the so-called pavattivāra.
pavattimattakathana: [ pavattimatta + kathana ] (thī, na) CL=7 Saying just happening or existing.
pavattimukha: [ pavatti + mukha ] (ti) CL=7 A cause of happening or existing.
pavattinimitta: [ pavatti + nimitta ] (na) CL=7 (1) A cause of happening or existing. (A) A cause of happening or occurring (such as sermon, desire). (B) A cause of happening or occurring (wisdom, saddā). Saddapavattinimita.
